description: `(route, state) => MaybeAsync<GuardResult>`. Decides whether a route may be entered. `state.url` is the URL being navigated to.
`(component, currentRoute, currentState, nextState) => ...`. Decides whether the user may leave the component of type `T`.
Decides whether a route config may even be **matched**. If it returns `false`, the router tries the next route; lazy code is not downloaded.
Returning a `UrlTree` (or `new RedirectCommand(tree, options)`) from a guard cancels the navigation and redirects.
`boolean | UrlTree | RedirectCommand`, optionally wrapped in a `Promise` or `Observable` (`MaybeAsync`).
Injectable classes implementing `CanActivate`. Deprecated since v15.2; wrap old ones with `mapToCanActivate([OldGuard])` while migrating.
